resources.string: SAMplay records what you watch in Bingers: every play that stops at 80% or more, and anything you mark as watched. Unmarking removes it there too.
On bingers.app/integrations, create a personal access token with Read + write access, then paste it here. The Bingers API needs the Legend or Icon plan.
SAMplay stops recording to Bingers on this profile and forgets the token. What is already in Bingers stays there.
Bingers did not accept this token. Check it, or create a new one.
This token can only read. Create one with Read + write access.
Bingers refused: its API needs the Legend or Icon plan and a token with Read + write access.
Bingers is busy (too many requests). SAMplay tries again shortly.
Could not reach Bingers. Check the connection and try again.
Bingers could not handle the request. Try again later.
